wgsim 2011.10.17
Licence: MIT (LICENSE in this folder: the notice of wgsim.c)
Upstream source: https://github.com/lh3/wgsim (commit a12da3375ff3b51a5594d4b6fa35591173ecc229)
WebAssembly build: Biowasm (https://biowasm.com/), downloaded from
  https://biowasm.com/cdn/v3/wgsim/2011.10.17/ on 2026-10-10
Build recipes: https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm (a pinned copy is in ../../../licenses/biowasm-build/)

The Biowasm build leaves out two things of the original (patch in ../../../licenses/biowasm-build/tools/wgsim/):
the list of the mutations that wgsim made, which the original prints on its standard output, and the
message about a reference sequence that is too short for the fragment length (it is skipped silently).

Local change to the JavaScript loader: exit(status) is recorded as Module.__exitStatus, so that the
terminal of the workbench keeps the exit status of a failed command.
Modified file: wgsim.js
wgsim.wasm is unmodified.
